journals.title: Lex Global Review of Law and Justice (LGRLJ)
journals.subtitle: Volume 1 · Issue 1
journals.tagline: “Justice · Scholarship · Integrity · Excellence” — An International Peer-Reviewed Law Journal
journals.description: Introduced by Lex Global Advocacy LLP, Mumbai, the Lex Global Review of Law and Justice (LGRLJ) is a flagship scholarly periodical dedicated to critical doctrinal jurisprudence, transnational commercial arbitration, cross-border treaty frameworks, and contemporary global justice.

team.name: Adv. Sanjay Patil
team.role: Former District Judge & Former President, District Consumer Commission
team.specialty: Judicial Adjudication, Consumer Protection & Appellate Practice
team.bio: Adv. Sanjay Patil is a revered jurist, Former District Judge, and Former President of the District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission with distinguished service in the Indian judicial system.

team.name: Adv. Kishor Vadane
team.role: Former District Judge & Former President, District Consumer Commission
team.specialty: Judicial Adjudication, Consumer Redressal & International Arbitration
team.bio: Advocate Kishor Vadane is a distinguished Former District Judge and Former President of the District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission who also leads cross-border commercial disputes and arbitration strategy.

team.name: Adv. Shridhar Kulkarni
team.role: Former District Judge & Former President, District Consumer Commission
team.specialty: Judicial Adjudication, Consumer Protection Appeals & Commercial Arbitration
team.bio: Former District and Additional Sessions Judge and Former President of the District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission in Maharashtra. Extensive judicial career adjudicating high-value civil disputes, statutory consumer appeals, and arbitration enforcement.

team.name: Prof. Dr. Santosh Keshav Kakade
team.role: Founder & CEO · Former President & Member, State Consumer Commission, Mumbai · Senior Medicolegal Consultant
team.specialty: Medical Law, Medicolegal Consultancy, Healthcare Governance, Consumer Dispute Resolution & AI/Cyber Governance
team.bio: Prof. Dr. Santosh Keshav Kakade is a distinguished legal academician, medical professional, surgeon and medicolegal consultant with over three decades of multidisciplinary experience in medicine, law, healthcare administration, consumer dispute resolution and legal education.

team.name: Adv. Ravindra Nagre
team.specialty: Civil, Criminal Trial Advocacy & Consumer Jurisprudence
team.bio: 27+ years of advocacy experience alongside dedicated judicial service as Former President of the District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission.

team.name: Adv. Anand Bhalchandra Joshi
team.specialty: B.A., LL.B., LL.M., GDC&A, Diploma in Cyber Law, Cr.Vastu Shastra · Consumer Protection, Cyber Law & Banking Liability
team.bio: Adv. Anand Bhalchandra Joshi (B.A., LL.B., LL.M., GDC&A, Diploma in Cyber Law, Cr.Vastu Shastra) served as Former President of the District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (DCDRC). Authority on consumer protection jurisprudence, cyber law, co-operative societies, banking deficiencies, and insurance claim repudiations.

team.name: Adv. Sanjay Borwal
team.specialty: Consumer Grievance Redressal & Public Utility Disputes
team.bio: Former President of the District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission with extensive competence in consumer grievance redressal forums (CGRF), public utility disputes, and builder-buyer contract enforcements.

team.name: Adv. Avinash Vinayak Prabhune
team.role: Former Member, Additional District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission, Nagpur
team.specialty: Consumer Protection, Electricity Regulatory Law (MERC / CGRF / Ombudsman) & Right to Information (RTI)
team.bio: B.A. LL.B. (RTMNU, Nagpur), Certificate Course in Consumer Protection (IGNOU), Diploma in Electrical Engineering. Served ~64+ months (May 2018 – Oct 2023) as Member, Addl. District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission, Nagpur; 21+ years in Consumer Protection, Electricity (MERC/CGRF/Ombudsman) & RTI; 36 years industry experience as MSPGCL Assistant Engineer; practising Advocate since October 2023.

team.name: Adv. Mahesh Dhake
team.specialty: BSL.LL.B., A.D.C.A., AI and Law · Consumer Redressal, Corporate Finance, Banking, D.R.T & Recovery
team.bio: 25+ years practicing advocate (BSL.LL.B., A.D.C.A., and AI and Law) and Former Member, District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission, Ahmednagar, specializing in banking, SARFAESI, D.R.T & corporate recovery.
